subject: KestrelAI - elevated model errors and recovery plan
messages:
From: Alex Novak <alex@kestrel.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Elevated 5xx/timeout errors - kestrel model endpoints

Hi Karthik,

We started seeing a spike in 5xx and timeout responses to generation requests hitting the /v1/generate endpoint around 07:45 PST this morning. Errors look concentrated on model id 'kestrel-3b-v2' and show timeouts at ~4-6s followed by a 502/504. Example request IDs attached (kestrel_error_sample_1130.log).

Impact: about 12% of requests from our production traffic are failing or timing out (visible in our dashboards). This is causing degraded UX for customers and a handful of automated retries. Can you confirm you see this and advise next steps?

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform, KestrelAI

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2027 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx/timeout errors - kestrel model endpoints

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the log bundle. We're seeing the same anomaly on our side correlated to the kestrel-3b-v2 variant. I’m looping in Aditya (inference ops) to triage immediately.

Immediate plan:
- Aditya will run a targeted triage and provide mitigation options (routing, temporary fallback).
- We’ll share a short mitigation window and keep you updated every 60–90 minutes until resolved.

Marissa is on the thread for customer comms and credits if needed. Sorry for the disruption — we’ll treat this with high priority.

— Karthik
Director, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Alex Novak <alex@kestrel.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2027 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx/timeout errors - kestrel model endpoints

On Mon, Nov 30, 2027 at 8:22 AM karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up ... looping in Aditya (inference ops) to triage immediately.

Thanks — quick update from triage: we see degraded KV cache hit rates and elevated GC pauses on the pod pool serving kestrel-3b-v2 for the 8:00–8:30 PST window. This aligns with the 5xx/timeouts in your traces.

Actions taken so far:
- Flushed prefix KV caches on affected nodes (reduced error surface but did not fully resolve).
- Shifted routing policy to send new traffic to kestrel-3b-v1 (compatible but slightly higher latency) for customers in your account. This is in effect now.
- Spun up an extra hot-replica group and applied a temporary patch to reduce aggressive cache eviction (rw-routing-change.patch attached).

Next steps and ETA:
- Further metric collection for 2 hours; if stable, we’ll revert routing back to v2 after a controlled canary (ETA 6–8 hrs).
- If instability persists, we’ll rollback the model version for your traffic and open a follow-up postmortem.

I’ll continue to post updates. Please share any additional traces/IDs if you see new errors.

— Aditya
Senior Inference Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Novak <alex@kestrel.ai>

Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx/timeout errors - kestrel model endpoints

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the rapid mitigation and the routing change. We see error rate drop from ~12% to ~1.5% after the switch to kestrel-3b-v1. A couple of questions:

1) Can you confirm whether any requests were dropped or not retried automatically during the switch (we saw a small blip in our client logs)?
2) Would you be able to share an ETA for a full revert to kestrel-3b-v2, or if you expect us to remain on v1 for longer?

Also, for our end-of-quarter review we may request a partial credit for the hours of degraded service — want to get a sense of the incident window for our account.

Best,
Alex

On a separate note, we’ll keep monitoring and will post any new traces to the ticket (RED-8421).

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alex Novak <alex@kestrel.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Elevated 5xx/timeout errors - kestrel model endpoints

Alex — final note on this incident and next steps.

Summary:
- Incident window: 2027-11-30T07:45 PST to 2027-11-30T13:30 PST (root cause activity and controlled canary completed).
- Impact: elevated 5xx/timeouts primarily on kestrel-3b-v2; we routed your traffic to kestrel-3b-v1 at 08:10 PST which reduced error rate to ~1–2%.
- Cause: cascading KV cache pressure on a subset of serving nodes combined with a memory compaction pattern that increased GC pauses during a rolling workload surge.

Resolution and follow-ups:
- Full revert to kestrel-3b-v2 completed after successful canary at 13:10 PST; we observed stable metrics for 20 minutes before moving traffic back.
- Engineering will deliver a short postmortem draft (attached: kestrel_postmortem-draft.pdf) that includes a permanent mitigations plan (hot-replica sizing, cache eviction tuning, and a change to our rolling-update cadence).
- We will also prepare a customer-impact summary for your review and a proposal for service credit where applicable. Marissa will follow up with the credit details.

Apologies again for the disruption. We’ve prioritized the permanent mitigations and will surface a final RCA and timeline for the fixes by next week.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference
